line_items.work_text: Protection and prevention of Anand Nagar area under North Guwahati revenue circle from landslide hazard near Aswaklanta Devalaya under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Kamrup District, Jalukbari LAC
Protection and prevention of Rangagarh Pathar to Ghilahdar Road from flood damages under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Darrang District of Assam.
Improvement of Road from NH-15 at Thekeraguri to Da Mati Sonapur for Disaster Mitigation Using Polymer Modified Bitumen and Coir Geotextile Bio-Mitigative Technology under SDMF for the year 2025-26.

Improvement of Road from Sri Sri Basudev Than to Nagpore with RCC Box Cell Culvert Incorporating Seismic Ductile Detailing and Cotton Waste Geotextile for Enhanced Disaster Resilience under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Lakhimpur District.

Improvement of road from SH-42 Ghilaramara Dhakukhana Road by constructing a guide bund with guide bund and synthetic geogrids at Ch. 2.475 Km Korha river bridge approach (Ghilarama side and Dhakukhana side) under SDMF for the year 2024-25 in Lakhimpur District.

narrative: 16th Appraisal committee held on 23rd December, 2025 recommended the proposals and directed to place it before the SEC.
